description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a controller class for managing themes in the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin interface. It handles listing, installation, and uninstallation of theme extensions, interacting with models, views, and other core components.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the Opencart admin extension, including listing, installing, and uninstalling themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of themes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed themes, including data for the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a theme extension, including permission checks, model updates, and autoload registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a theme extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
